title: Account Credit Deposit Terms — Harborline Customer Accounts
content:
# Account credit deposit terms

> Harborline Customer Accounts

Harborline account credit is available to pay for any Harborline product. Deposits, refunds taken as credit and goodwill credits add to it; purchases paid from credit, withdrawals and charge-back reversals take from it.

## Terms

1. A deposit may be accepted only while the account status is active.
2. A single deposit must be at least the tier's minimum deposit and at most the tier's maximum per transaction, and must use one of the tier's deposit methods.
3. A bank transfer must be at least the tier's bank transfer minimum.
4. A deposit that would raise the credit balance above the tier's maximum credit balance is refused in full, never accepted in part.
5. After every credit ledger entry the account's credit balance is set to the previous balance plus the entry's signed amount, so it always equals the sum of the account's ledger entries.
6. Deposited credit never expires and carries no interest.
7. Every credit amount is rounded half up to the cent.

## Deposit limits by tier

| Tier | Minimum single deposit | Maximum single deposit | Maximum credit balance after a deposit | Deposit methods | Bank transfer minimum | Rounding of credit amounts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harborline Personal Account | $25.00 | $2500.00 | $5000.00 | card, PayPal | $0.00 (bank transfer not offered) | half up to the cent |
| Harborline Business Account | $25.00 | $5000.00 | $10000.00 | card, PayPal | $0.00 (bank transfer not offered) | half up to the cent |
| Harborline Reseller Bronze | $100.00 | $10000.00 | $25000.00 | card, PayPal, bank transfer | $500.00 | half up to the cent |
| Harborline Reseller Silver | $100.00 | $25000.00 | $50000.00 | card, PayPal, bank transfer | $500.00 | half up to the cent |
| Harborline Reseller Gold | $250.00 | $50000.00 | $100000.00 | card, PayPal, bank transfer | $1000.00 | half up to the cent |
| Harborline Reseller Platinum | $250.00 | $100000.00 | $250000.00 | card, PayPal, bank transfer | $1000.00 | half up to the cent |

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

| Account | Deposit offered | Judgement |
|---|---|---|
| Harborline Reseller Silver, balance $49612.50 | $600.00 by card | Refused in full: the balance would become $50212.50, above $50000.00. A part deposit of $387.50 is not taken in its place. |
| Harborline Reseller Gold, active | $900.00 by bank transfer | Not accepted: below the $1000.00 bank transfer minimum. |
| Harborline Reseller Gold, active | $900.00 by card | Accepted: at least $250.00 and at most $50000.00. |
| Harborline Personal Account, active | $40.00 by bank transfer | Not accepted: bank transfer is not a deposit method of the tier. |
| Harborline Business Account, locked | $60.00 by PayPal | Not accepted: the account status is not active. |

## Balance after an entry (hypothetical)

A balance of $118.35 followed by a deposit of $75.00 becomes $193.35; a later entry paying a $41.90 charge from credit, a signed amount of minus $41.90, leaves $151.45, which is the sum of the account's ledger entries.
